title: Quiz: promises beat timers, even at 0
why_it_matters: It explains odd orderings in your console logs.
explanation: JavaScript runs normal code first, then promise callbacks, then timers. Promise callbacks sit in a faster queue called the microtask queue. So even a 0ms timeout loses to an already-resolved promise.
try_it: Predict the order if you add a second Promise.resolve().then(...) line.
